The A/A cell is the locked plan's own form re-flown in the SAME campaign chain, so the treatment delta is read against a within-chain null.

margins.source: the plan's own null on this roster, cell PLANr (SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-REPLICATE-V1)

decision_rule_fixed_here: NEUTRAL: both guards non-inferior at the plan's own null -- the CI95 lower bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta above -h_slu and of the intent delta above -h_intent, each measured against the IN-CHAIN A/A arm, not against the sealed comparator alone. ADMITTED: NEUTRAL and the SLU CI95 lower bound above zero against the in-chain A/A. HARMFUL: a measured loss on either guard (decision 25). Every verdict carries the per-stratum table in both weightings, the frontier row (decision 75), the delivery-rate check (did the flown arm deliver the gold intent's boundary entry on the rows the offline replication says it would?) and the measured token delta.
development_numbers_only: Every number this cell will produce is a TRAIN Fold A construction-fold development number (owner decisions 28 and 86) and is never a test claim.
failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run.

default_byte_identity.claim: At w_agree 0.0 with no agreement_source, the first-phase selection this implementation prepares is byte-identical to the selection the sealed comparator flew, on all 1,080 rows.

production_path_replication.claim: The production path reproduces the diagnostic's own delivery numbers on all three rosters.

one_factor: The intent-boundary Perception channel reads its own registered w_agree term over a pre-computed, self-excluded exemplar-intent vote: w_agree 1.0, w_cos unchanged at 1.0, w_prior unchanged at 0.0, and the DELIVERED width unchanged at 8 entries (fuse_coverage m 8 / c 1 / top_l 8). The RECALL width k moves from 8 to the store's full 60, because k is the provider's top_k_per_dimension and truncates by cosine BEFORE the ranker runs -- at 8 the agreement term is inert, measured. The widening is a proven no-op on its own: the in-chain A/A control carries k 60 at w_agree 0.0 and reproduces the sealed comparator's first-phase output digest AND its rendered request bytes exactly, so the two arms differ in w_agree alone. Nothing else moves.
prohibitions: No paper-scale profile. No confirmatory or test-split contact. No Fold B or DEV read from this cell. No re-flying of the sealed comparator. No second factor. No w_prior change. No k change. No store rebuild or release. No admission entry from this registration, and no flight before root mints the decision receipt and all three cells are flipped.

what_a_neutral_read_would_mean: That delivery does not convert to correctness at a rate this design can see -- which is mode (iv) of the read, delivered but ignored or misused, and is the programme's next question rather than a defect of this cell. It must be reported as such and never as 'no gain'.
why_the_delivered_width_is_not_widened: The missing gold intents are not bunched just outside the window; they are spread down the whole tail (Fold A: 37 % at ranks 9-16, 32 % at 17-30, 28 % at 31-60, 3 % unrankable), so a delivered width of 16 leaves over two thirds still missing on every roster. The nearest width that buys the same delivery, 30, costs +3,262.3 tokens per row against this change's +1.4 -- about 2,330 times the form cost, and that added form is exactly what sank the index arm at SLU -7.37. The delivered width stays at 8 (fuse_coverage m 8 / c 1 / top_l 8), and the flown block still carries eight entries: the measured selected-value count is 8,624 on both arms, identical.
why_the_recall_width_does_move: PhaseSupplySpec.k is the provider's top_k_per_dimension, so the RECALL truncates to the top k BY COSINE before the ranker is called. At k = 8 the agreement term can only permute the eight the cosine already chose and cannot reach a gold intent at rank 9-60 -- which is the entire population the read measured. MEASURED, and this is why the brief's 'k left at 8' had to be corrected: at k = 8 the treatment is INERT, wrong-row delivery 45.0 % -> 45.0 % on all three rosters. The recall width therefore moves to the store's full 60, which is the width the read's own simulation used. The delivered width is unchanged, because KbFacetProvider.fuse reads the full RankResult and its own FuseKnobs, never k. AND THE WIDENING IS A PROVEN NO-OP ON ITS OWN: the in-chain A/A control carries k = 60 at w_agree 0.0 and its own prepared first-phase supply reproduces the sealed comparator's output digest ba5e1faab9550fcae700f649a0ec6674327ffefe97d7044bb7ea3887536fb54f exactly, on all 1,080 rows. The two arms therefore differ in w_agree alone.
why_w_prior_is_untouched: It is DEAD on this channel, not merely zeroed. Measured on the released snapshot, 0 of the 60 boundary values carry a prior_score and 0 carry a task_target, and the channel recalls one dimension, intent-boundary, which is not in rails.kb_policy.PRIOR_MASS_DIMENSIONS -- so max_prior is 0.0 for every candidate on every row and w_prior has no effect at any value. Turning it on would be a store rebuild, and the offline simulation showed it destroys correct rows above 0.15. This cell does not touch it and no config here implies it works.
